name: Federal laws of Mexico (Constitution, codes and laws in force)
label: Mexico
record_note: 9 federal laws in force on SCJN Legislación (1 constitution, 8 codes, 0 laws): every consolidated text SCJN gives, one per DOF publication, to the in-force date of 2026-10-08; data retrieved up to 2026-10-28.

dates.commit: in-force: the decree's own first transitorio, read from the SCJN extracto; held back when an earlier change printed in the same text was still pending
dates.before_1970: clamped to 1970-01-01, one second apart in order

author.amendment: the decree (or fe de erratas) of the DOF publication SCJN made the text for

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Mexico; transitional provisions are in transitorios/ of each law

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect to the detriment of any person
default_reach.meaning: a law may not be given retroactive effect to anyone's detriment; it may reach back in their favour
default_reach.authority: Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos, art. 14, first paragraph; Código Civil Federal, arts. 3, 4 and 5
